name: Data story
description: A vertical numbers story for any business: a headline, one big number, a ranked list of your top three to five items with bars drawn from their values, a closing line and an end card with your logo. Up to three photos of your own behind it; without them your brand colours show. 40 s, also cut to 30 s and to 15 s (the headline, the list and the end card). Its music is "Deep House 003" by Sascha Ende (CC BY 4.0) from 32.0 s; the post's copy carries its credit.

kicker.label: Label above the headline
kicker.description: A few words above the headline, e.g. SEPTEMBER IN NUMBERS. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: What the numbers say, in one line, e.g. Our busiest month yet. Spoken as the video opens.

stat_value.label: Big number
stat_value.description: The one number to remember, as it should read, e.g. 1,240 or 96%.

stat_label.label: What the big number counts
stat_label.description: The words after it, e.g. loaves out of the oven. Spoken with the number.

stat_note.label: Line under the big number
stat_note.description: Context for the number, e.g. Up from 980 last September. Leave empty for none.

ranking_title.label: Ranking title
ranking_title.description: What the list ranks, e.g. Most ordered this month. Spoken before the list.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The word after every value in the list, e.g. orders or kg. Leave empty for none.

item_1_name.label: Top item 1: name
item_1_name.description: The item ranked 1, e.g. Sourdough. Spoken with its value.

item_1_value.label: Top item 1: value
item_1_value.description: Its number, e.g. 412. The bars are drawn from these values.

item_2_name.label: Top item 2: name
item_2_name.description: The item ranked 2, e.g. Sourdough. Spoken with its value.

item_2_value.label: Top item 2: value
item_2_value.description: Its number, e.g. 412. The bars are drawn from these values.

item_3_name.label: Top item 3: name
item_3_name.description: The item ranked 3, e.g. Sourdough. Spoken with its value.

item_3_value.label: Top item 3: value
item_3_value.description: Its number, e.g. 412. The bars are drawn from these values.

item_4_name.label: Top item 4: name
item_4_name.description: The item ranked 4. Spoken in the 40 s video. Leave it empty for a shorter list.

item_4_value.label: Top item 4: value
item_4_value.description: Its number, e.g. 412. The bars are drawn from these values. Ignored when its name is empty.

item_5_name.label: Top item 5: name
item_5_name.description: The item ranked 5. Spoken in the 40 s video. Leave it empty for a shorter list.

item_5_value.label: Top item 5: value
item_5_value.description: Its number, e.g. 412. The bars are drawn from these values. Ignored when its name is empty.

closing_line.label: Closing line
closing_line.description: The line before the end card, e.g. Thank you for keeping us busy. Spoken.

end_line.label: End card line
end_line.description: Under your name on the end card, e.g. Order ahead online. Spoken with your name. Leave empty for none.

end_url.label: End card address
end_url.description: Your web address or handle, e.g. yourbrand.com. Leave empty for none.

still_1.label: Photo behind the opening
still_1.description: 9:16 photo with no words in it: your place, your team or your product. Behind the headline and the big number, 0-9.6 s. Without it, your brand colours show.

still_2.label: Photo behind the list
still_2.description: 9:16 photo with no words in it, darkened behind the ranked list, 9.6-27 s. Without it, your brand colours show.

still_3.label: Photo behind the close
still_3.description: 9:16 photo with no words in it, behind the closing line and the end card, 27-40 s. Without it, your brand colours show.

sample_data.headline: Our busiest month yet.
sample_data.closing_line: Thank you for keeping us busy.
